title: Lake Country Full Day Lunch Wine Tour-Incl. Tastings & Guide Grat
includes: Door to door pick up and drop off in Vernon or Lake Country
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Our most popular tour! Take in breathtaking views along Lake Okanagan while you sip some fabulous vintages from some very impressive vineyards. 

The Holy Sip Lunch tour includes tastings at 5 wineries with up to 24 wine tasted, with ample time for a relaxed scenic and delicious lunch at a vineyard (lunch cost is not included).

If your tour does not meet the minimum, guests will be switched to appropriate tour.
